gaussian_blur.body:
TileLang’s CUDA codegen always emits __launch_bounds__(threads, 1). For Gaussian blur, that tells ptxas to optimize for only one resident block and causes aggressive load hoisting, 255 registers/thread, and
  occupancy collapse. yes from gpt

jacobi_stencil_2d.body:
nvcc recognizes that left/right neighbors are already present in TileLang’s center-vector load. It reduces 17 logical loads to 11.
    Triton retains all 17

2d_max_pooling.body: TileLang chooses a better lane layout. Triton’s stride-2 stencil loads touch 26.67 L1 sectors/request versus TileLang’s 8.06. This is a coalescing/layout win.
